claims.proves: the existing skill entrypoint exits with the expected status
claims.does_not_prove: semantic correctness, live service behavior, or full skill readiness

cases.name: depends-on-renders-machine-readable-blocker
command: ../run.sh maintenance 'depends-on eval' --target skills/ticket --invariant 'dependency marker is rendered' --cleanup 'preview only' --scoped-files skills/ticket --proof 'cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills && skills/agentic-evals/run.sh run skills/ticket/fixtures/agentic_eval.json --case depends-on-renders-machine-readable-blocker --output /tmp/ticket_depends_on_eval.json shows READY' --route backend_python_or_skill_runtime --depends-on grahama1970/pdf_oxide#31 > /tmp/ticket_depends_on_preview.out && grep -q 'blocked-by: grahama1970/pdf_oxide#31' /tmp/ticket_depends_on_preview.out && grep -q 'depends_on: grahama1970/pdf_oxide#31' /tmp/ticket_depends_on_preview.out

cases.name: routable-requires-agentic-eval
command: repo=$(git -C .. rev-parse --show-toplevel) && cd "$repo/skills/ticket" && uv run --project . python scripts/eval_routable_requires_agentic_eval.py

cases.name: close-audit-parses-markdown-scoped-files
cases.notes: Regression guard for Markdown issue bodies such as '- **Scoped files:** ...'. The close wrapper must scope the worktree audit from the machine-readable scoped-files line instead of falling back to every dirty secondary worktree.

cases.name: bug-preview-does-not-require-unrelated-preflight
command: repo=$(git -C .. rev-parse --show-toplevel) && cd "$repo/skills/ticket" && ./run.sh bug 'Ticket preview preflight false-positive guard' --target skills/ticket --observed 'A Codex pre-tool hook falsely blocked ticket creation as a preflight-required batch operation while filing a non-LLM issue.' --expected 'Ticket preview generation stays a local issue-body compiler and does not invoke or require unrelated preflight.' --repro 'Preview this ticket with no --apply and inspect stdout.' --proof 'skills/agentic-evals/run.sh run skills/ticket/fixtures/agentic_eval.json --case bug-preview-does-not-require-unrelated-preflight --output /tmp/ticket_preflight_false_positive_eval.json shows READY' --route backend_python_or_skill_runtime --lane be --agent coder --label type:bug > /tmp/ticket_preflight_false_positive_preview.out 2>&1 && grep -q 'Ticket preview preflight false-positive guard' /tmp/ticket_preflight_false_positive_preview.out && ! grep -q 'Before running batch LLM operations' /tmp/ticket_preflight_false_positive_preview.out && ! grep -q 'batch-quality/cli.py preflight' /tmp/ticket_preflight_false_positive_preview.out && grep -q 'route:backend_python_or_skill_runtime' /tmp/ticket_preflight_false_positive_preview.out && grep -q 'lane:be' /tmp/ticket_preflight_false_positive_preview.out
cases.notes: Regression guard for the 2026-08-26 incident where a local Codex hook misclassified non-LLM ticket creation as requiring preflight. This proves the ticket CLI preview path is local and does not emit or depend on that gate; Codex PreToolUse hook behavior must be tested separately at the hook layer.
